disclosure: This sends your sequences and ligands to Boltz's hosted API under your own Boltz API key. Boltz bills each prediction to that account by measured compute (published from $0.025 per sample for small inputs); DNAForge does not charge for it. A test-mode key runs for free but returns fake structures.
retentionNote: Boltz keeps prediction inputs and results for 7 days by default (14 at most), and its result download links expire sooner. DNAForge saves the structure into your workspace when the job finishes.

cancellation.note: Boltz cannot cancel a structure prediction after submission; it will finish and may still be billed.
